name: Upload for Jelly
description: Accepts photo uploads from a client and files them into a photo library.
overview: Photo upload endpoint for photo libraries.

versions.changelog: First published release. Uploads go only into a library an administrator ticks on the plugin's page; none is open by default. Targets lists where the caller may write, Have answers which photos the server is missing, and Items streams a photo in, verifies its hash and files it under its capture month. A photo with no date inside the file takes the date from the name the plugin gave it. Requires Jellyfin 10.11.6. The endpoints may still change before 1.0.0.0.
